summary: Serpline checks the SEO and AI crawler access of the page you are on. Everything is worked out in your browser, and nothing is sent to us.
reads: The page in the current tab, after you click the icon or press the shortcut.
The raw HTML of that same page, and the robots.txt and llms.txt of that site, fetched straight from the site.
The status of internal links on the page, only when you press Check links or turn that setting on. These requests go to the same site.
stores: Settings on your computer: language, Google preview device and the link check switch.
Results stay in the side panel until you close it.
never: Crawl a whole site or check pages you did not open it on
Send pages or results to any server
Keep a history of the sites you checked
Read what you type into forms

perms.name: activeTab
perms.why: Read the current tab after you click the icon.

perms.name: scripting
perms.why: Run the reading function in that tab.

perms.name: sidePanel
perms.why: Show Serpline next to the page.

perms.name: storage
perms.why: Save your settings on your computer.

perms.name: Site access (optional)
perms.why: Asked for one site at a time, only when you press Check this page. Chrome shows its own prompt, and you can remove it in Chrome settings.

notes: Requests to the site you check work like reloading the page: your browser sends that site’s own cookies, as it always does.
The audit PDF is made in your browser.
